dossier.headline: MSCI adds four Indian stocks, removes PI Industries
dossier.summary: MSCI's November review, announced overnight on November 11, adds LIC, Coforge, Adani Green Energy and Meesho to its Global Standard index and removes PI Industries, effective November 30. Nuvama estimates inflows of about $630 million into Coforge and $468 million into LIC, and India's weight in the MSCI Emerging Markets index rises to 11.7% from 11.5%.
why_it_matters: Index inclusion brings passive foreign money into the added stocks
A higher India weight adds to the strong foreign inflows seen this month
watch: Share reactions in the four additions and in PI Industries
Flows around the November 30 effective date
questions: How much of the expected inflow is already priced in?
conflicts: Before the review, JM Financial expected OFSS and Siemens Energy India to be removed; only PI Industries was reported as removed
Pre-review inflow estimates (JM Financial: about $1.4 billion net) differ from post-review estimates (about $2 billion)
